name: module_base_160x120
notes: Common 25 mm M3 grid and four M5 slots. Bolt modules to plywood or 2020 rails.

name: cable_clip_dual
notes: Two small cable channels; use zip ties for strain relief.

name: electronics_box
notes: Holds Uno, ESP32 bridge, A4988s, DC modules, terminal blocks. Keep motor power and logic wiring separated.

name: electronics_vented_lid
notes: Ventilated lid; use M3 screws.

name: ili9341_bezel
notes: Generic 2.2 inch ILI9341 bezel. Verify your PCB outline before final print.

name: spool_stand_left
notes: Pair supports a 5 mm axle with 608 bearings; 120 mm maximum spool diameter.

name: spool_stand_right
notes: Pair supports a 5 mm axle with 608 bearings; 120 mm maximum spool diameter.

name: spool_hub
notes: Two hubs clamp the veneer reel on 5 mm axle. Add felt washers for passive drag.

name: dancer_arm
notes: Spring-loaded dancer arm; potentiometer or hall sensor may track position.

name: dancer_roller
notes: Use M3 shoulder screw or smooth axle; optionally sleeve with silicone tube.

name: veneer_guide_45deg_lower
notes: 4.6 x 1.2 mm smooth guide channel. Rotate entire bracket to calibrated winding angle.

name: veneer_guide_lid
notes: Light lid for F06; M2 screws, do not pinch strip.

name: nema17_rotation_mount
notes: NEMA17 face mount; use purchased flexible coupler + small collet/pin vise for 0.8 mm mandrel.

name: 608_mandrel_support
notes: 608 bearing support for driven chuck/shaft; mandrel itself is metal, not printed.

name: lm8uu_linear_carriage
notes: Two 15.4 mm LM8UU bores, 56 mm apart. Clamp bearings with zip ties through slots.

name: t8_nut_carrier
notes: Fits common flange T8 anti-backlash nut. Confirm your nut hole pattern; ream if needed.

name: mandrel_end_guide
notes: 2.2 mm bore accepts a short brass/PTFE guide tube around the steel mandrel.

name: camera_tilt_mount
notes: Adjustable RealSense/USB camera adapter mount; add camera-specific plate with M3 slots.

name: micro_release_clamp_lower
notes: Split demold collar. Tune the silicone-lined opening to the measured wet coil OD; closes lightly while mandrel retracts.

name: micro_release_clamp_upper
notes: Mate W07. This is a fit-test mechanism; wet demolding must be validated before unattended operation.

name: sg90_clamp_mount
notes: SG90/MG90S-class clamp bracket; verify exact servo body dimensions.

name: soft_clamp_jaw
notes: Bond 1 mm silicone pad to jaw. Clamp sacrificial tail/handling tab, not active coils.

name: guarded_shear_mount
notes: Universal mount for purchased spring-return micro shear. Do not print the blade.

name: cutter_guard
notes: Bench guard shell. Production guard should be transparent impact-rated polycarbonate with interlock.

name: tail_former_left
notes: Split wet-forming mandrel, 14 mm radius, 4.8 mm channel. Experimental geometry.

name: tail_former_right
notes: Mate with T01. Split enables wet release without dragging over an undercut.

name: tail_sweep_shoe
notes: Servo-driven smooth sweep shoe. Line strip-contact surface with PTFE tape.

name: tail_blank_clamp
notes: Light clamp for auxiliary tail blank during forming.

name: seed_hopper
notes: Species-specific low-cost gravity hopper. Use only dry seeds; pocket disk below throat meters one seed.

name: seed_singulator_disk_6mm
notes: Six 6.8 mm pockets over 180 degrees for a 28BYJ-48 indexing mechanism. Regenerate pocket size per seed species.

name: 28byj_seed_indexer_mount
notes: Mounts 28BYJ-48 below singulator disk; use metal M3 standoffs if needed.

name: three_tail_assembly_nest
notes: Three 120 degree tail channels around central tip cavity. Use soft inserts where body contacts fixture.

name: 10ml_syringe_holder
notes: Nominal 20-21 mm syringe barrel. Measure syringe before final print.

name: syringe_plunger_carriage
notes: M5 threaded-rod plunger carriage driven by 28BYJ-48. Add current/time limit to prevent overpressure.

name: tip_mold_half_A
material: PETG mold master / silicone working insert
notes: Two identical mold masters; clamp face-to-face around the seed/tail junction. Validate paste, release and seed viability; do not heat live seed.

name: tip_mold_half_B
material: PETG mold master / silicone working insert
notes: Two identical mold masters; clamp face-to-face around the seed/tail junction. Validate paste, release and seed viability; do not heat live seed.

name: free_dry_tray
notes: Free-dry tray: no clamps on wet wood. Use PTFE/silicone mesh liner and room-temperature airflow.

name: 120mm_usb_fan_bracket
notes: Holds a standard 120 mm USB fan above/beside trays. No heater required for R1.

name: camera_led_ring_plate
notes: Camera/LED ring plate for consistent defect-imaging illumination. Adapt center aperture to camera lens.

name: finished_seedpod_tray_12
notes: Twelve isolated finished-carrier nests. Increase pocket diameter after measuring dry carrier envelope.

name: gantry_tool_plate
notes: Universal plate for low-cost XY gantry or recycled 3D-printer carriage.

name: sg90_gripper_body
notes: SG90/MG90S body for transfer gripper. Grip only inactive tab/fixture, never squeeze active coil.

name: soft_gripper_finger
notes: Pair of padded fingers for inactive handling tab or transfer fixture.

name: vwheel_or_mgn12_carriage_adapter
notes: Generic adapter to a recycled Ender-style V-wheel carriage or MGN12 block.

name: gt2_nema17_corner_mount
notes: Corner motor mount for optional XY transfer gantry. Use 2020 extrusion and GT2 belt; two motors if no donor printer.

name: gt2_idler_corner_mount
notes: Adjustable idler mount for 5 mm bore GT2 idler. Tighten only enough to remove belt slack.

name: xy_tool_carriage
notes: Tool carriage accepts R01. Adapt to V-wheel or MGN12 donor hardware.

name: z_lift_servo_mount
notes: SG90/MG90S Z-lift mount for approximately 15-20 mm pickup travel. Keep end effector light.

name: fit_calibration_coupon
notes: Hole sizes for M2/M3/M4/M5, 8 mm rod and LM8UU; channel widths for wet veneer. Print before the rest of the system.

name: four_cell_payload_cassette
notes: Four isolated cells prevent tail entanglement. Payload only: use a purchased, flight-tested quadcopter frame.

name: single_drop_door
notes: One door per cell. Use 3 mm metal hinge pin and retained metal servo linkage; bench-test fail-closed latch.

name: payload_servo_mount
notes: SG90/MG90S mount outside cassette walls.

name: payload_rail_adapter
notes: Universal slotted payload plate. Do not use as motor/arm structure. Verify CG and landing gear clearance.

name: pi_zero2w_companion_plate
notes: Pi Zero 2 W / small companion plate. Use Pi 5 only if heavier onboard vision is needed.

name: downward_camera_mount
notes: Downward camera mount with lens opening; angle/height must be calibrated to ground sampling distance.
